blocks.text: You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-23) on the map (A-H). There are THREE extra options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

Extract One
*You will hear an interview with a woman called Adriana Moretti, who works as a wildlife photographer.*

items.q: What disadvantage does Adriana say her work has?
options: A) She sometimes feels lonely when she is working abroad.
B) She doesn’t see her family as often as she would like to.
C) She always has to go where the agency tells her.

items.q: Adriana believes it is becoming harder to get work as a wildlife photographer because …
options: A) so many photos of wildlife are available on the Internet.
B) there is a lot of competition for jobs in wildlife photography.
C) people are becoming less interested in wildlife.

blocks.text:
Extract Two
*You will hear an interview with travel writer Amy McCarthy about her first experience of travelling abroad.*

items.q: When she was at the airport, Amy felt …
options: A) glad she had taken sandwiches with her.
B) worried that she might miss her plane.
C) annoyed that she had spent so much.

items.q: Amy’s friend Carla annoyed Amy because Carla …
options: A) sometimes left dirty dishes in the living room.
B) often forgot her keys when she went out.
C) wouldn’t do any food shopping.

blocks.text:
Extract Three
*You will hear an interview with someone who was involved in the music business.*

items.q: What does James say about his ideas?
options: A) Some of them are not very realistic.
B) He expects to have good ones all the time.
C) He makes sure that he doesn’t forget them.

items.q: James’s advice to listeners who might want to go into business is to …
options: A) forget about past problems.
B) learn from past mistakes.
C) take big risks.
